title: Warm Crunchy Kenyan Almonds Wrap
description: A briny, crunchy, and energizing Kenyan dish featuring ssamjang and katsuramuki-cut almonds, perfect for a kosher-friendly breakfast or snack.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a small skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the katsuramuki-cut almonds to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add the ssamjang, salt, black pepper, chili flakes, crushed red pepper, and sesame seeds to the skillet and cook for 30 seconds, until the mixture is well combined.
Warm the kosher-friendly tortilla in the skillet for 30 seconds, until slightly puffed.
Sprinkle the chopped cilantro and lemon juice over the tortilla.
Assemble the wrap by spreading the toasted almond mixture down the center of the tortilla, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the bottom edge of the tortilla up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
Cut the wrap in half and serve immediately.
Serve warm, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
